title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-agent-project-memory-in-repo: carry parked/agent/project-memory-in-repo onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/agent/project-memory-in-repo` at 0ba623bb8e holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: agents/AGENTS.md, agents/PROJECT-INSTRUCTIONS.md, docs/BOOTSTRAP-GAPS.md, docs/bootstrapping/bootstrap-log.md, scripts/check_memory.py, seed/.github/workflows/memory-fresh.yml)
**Done check:** probe:git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/parked/agent/project-memory-in-repo is 0, or the branch's content is carried by a merged change
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 1 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M
